thread:
alex: Heads upwe have multiple enterprise deals asking for automated evidence packs + per-tenant retention controls. Need product + infra alignment before next release.

maria: High level MVP ideas:
- searchable audit index (schema v1) with incremental rebuild
- scheduled export job that produces signed bundles (manifest + checksums) to customer S3/GCS
- retention policy engine with legal-hold override and history/audit trail

jonathan: Two questions: SLA for ad-hoc evidence queries? And who owns the enforcement (soft vs hard deletes)?

sam: Suggest two access modes: "live index" for recent data (<60s for last 7 days) and "export pack" for full historical evidence (job, hours depending on size). Enforcement should live in infra, product owns policy UI + changelog. :gear:

katie: BYOK implications: if tenant uses customer-managed keys we must include per-tenant key metadata, handshake records, and rotation logs. Also pack should optionally be encrypted with tenant key or left encrypted-at-rest only. Need legal on acceptable format for auditors.

maria: Proposed retention config example:
```
retention:
  - id: standard
    months: 12
  - id: extended
    months: 24
  - id: litigation_archive
    months: 36
legal_hold_enabled: true
byok_handshake_required: true
```

alex: Safety: auto-deletion needs dry-run mode, admin approval for purge >30d, and a changelog. Also retention changes must be immutable once exported as evidence.

jonathan: Enforcement notes: infra to implement a purge pipeline with phased states: soft-delete (30d), escrowed (until purge confirmed), final-erase. We should also emit telemetry: retention_change, object_deleted, purge_confirmed.

sam: Export pack format: include
- manifest.json (checksums, version, object counts)
- events.ndjson (snapshoted at job start)
- access_audit.log (who requested pack, IP, timestamp)
- byok_handshake.json (if applicable)
Pack should be signed by our pack-signer key and optionally encrypted for tenant.

katie: @legal please review whether manifest + handshake + access_audit satisfy SOC2 evidence requirements. Also clarify retention allowed ranges when litigation hold is active. :warning:

legal: Quick read: manifest + access logs + BYOK handshake look good as evidence. Need to ensure chain-of-custody is captured (who requested, who downloaded, transfer logs). For litigation hold, customers can request indefinite hold but we need process and TOS language; ops will need manual override flows.

compliance-bot: Note  Compliance epic C-142 updated: design in progress. Next milestone: spec draft due. :white_check_mark:

alex: Open questions:
- pack size limits / quota and pricing implications
- support for cross-region exports (EU data residency)
- retention-change rollback policy and auditability

maria: Action items:
- I will write the API contract for search + export (schema v1) by EOD Wed
- jonathan please draft purge safety & SLA tiers by Fri
- sam to prototype pack signer + manifest format and a sample pack by next week
- katie to get legal sign-off and produce an auditor checklist template
- alex to run a stakeholder design call tomorrow 10:00am PT (invite in calendar)

jonathan: Also adding required telemetry counters to the spec: export_requested, export_completed, export_failed, retention_modified, retention_purge_started, retention_purge_completed. These must be queryable per-tenant for audits.

sam: Will include a small local CLI to simulate pack generation for the design review.

alex: Great discussion. We'll capture the spec and ship an initial alpha to a couple of pilot customers. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
